class.name: NetwPredictStats
class.brief_description: Prediction counters for one [NetwEntity], reached by [member NetwPredictionHandle.stats].
class.description: Use these for debug overlays and charts. To react to a correction, connect to the [NetwPredictionHandle] signals. [codeblock] var stats := NetwEntity.of(self).prediction.stats print("%d corrections" % stats.corrections) [/codeblock]
